profile.headline: at Google
profile.summary:
Senior software architect who consistently delivers effective, robust solutions to complex business and technical problems.  Awarded software patent 6,305007: “Object Property Meta Model Emulator For Legacy Data Structures”, Oscar and Emmy Technical Achievement awards.

Specialties: Object Oriented Analysis, Executable UML, Mission Critical Systems, Enterprise-level Software Architecture, Application Architecture, Logical Data Modeling

positions.description: Earthsongs made beautiful custom tiles for our master bath.  We are delighted with the results.

positions.description: Analyze business requirements and support deployment of the RightAccess and RightCommerce suites in support of soft goods ecommerce.

positions.description: Joined Macrovision when they acquired eMeta.  Developed and deployed solutions around the RightAccess and RightCommerce web entitlement and soft good e-commerce packages.
